name: Kuromine Ai
source:
An S-Class Worrier

Occupation: Middle school teacher
Height: About average
Breast Size: Big

Ai is a woman who met the protagonist by chance at the hospital. Even there, she was constantly worrying about something. At first, it seemed like it was the environment, but it turned out that she was naturally a worrywart. 

As a middle school teacher, Ai is constantly fretting over thoughts like, "What if a boy with raging hormones comes after me...?"

Despite her worrisome nature, she has high self-esteem. 
Ai was stressing out, thinking, "It would be such a waste if a beauty like me ended up an old maid..." That's when she crossed paths with the protagonist.

[Translated/edited from official website]

[spoiler]
Her age is implied to be close to or more than 30 years old and she has dated several men in the past. Despite all that, she was still sexually inexperienced until she met the protagonist.
[/spoiler]
